battle.name: 美國入侵巴拿馬
battle.brief: 1989年12月20日凌晨零時四十六分，美軍在巴拿馬城與運河區同時開火，五日內瓦解巴拿馬國防軍。卡面M1A1艾布拉姆斯主戰坦克本身未參戰：街巷作戰交給空投的M551雪里登輕坦克與M2布萊德利，這件美軍裝甲師主戰坦克要到1991年海灣戰爭才首次實戰。

kit.name: M1A1艾布拉姆斯主戰坦克
kit.history: M1A1是美國陸軍裝甲師的主要主戰坦克，與裝甲步兵協同執行突破、防禦及要點占領任務，並構成師級裝甲骨幹。

countries: 這場衝突在形式上是美國與巴拿馬兩個國家之間的戰爭，實際上卻是美國單方面對巴拿馬國防軍的一場代號「正義事業」的立體戰役，沒有前線談判，也沒有戰俘交換。開火的權力與理由都在華盛頓：總統喬治·H·W·布希在12月16日批准方案、17日簽署命令，參謀長聯席會議主席科林·鮑威爾在幕後推動作戰概念，南部司令部司令喬治·克里斯特中將執掌戰區，第十八空降軍司令詹姆斯·科林斯中將指揮投入的地面部隊。地面主力是第82空降師，負責巴拿馬城與運河區方向；第7步兵師（輕裝）負責北部科倫省與科科索羅一線；第5步兵師（輕裝）第1營第61步兵團、第4營第6步兵團與第75遊騎兵團被派往里奧阿托等外圍要點；聯合特種作戰特遣隊轄下有海軍海豹突擊隊、第160空軍特種作戰團的MH-6輕型直升機與夜視器材，另有大批軍事警察部隊進城接管重要設施。巴拿馬一方的國防軍由諾列加本人直接掌握，總兵力約一萬六千人，絕大部分集中在巴拿馬城與運河區，其餘分散在科倫、戴維與聖米格爾；空軍只有數架老舊的A-37攻擊機與T-39螺旋槍運輸機，海軍只有巡邏艇與內河汽艇，既沒有能與美國艦隊對抗的水面大艦，也沒有成建制的主戰坦克部隊。兩軍真正的差距不在人數，而在制空權、夜視器材、戰術航空兵與空運能力。
countriesEn: In form this was a war between the United States and Panama, but in practice it was a unilateral American campaign against the Panamanian Defence Force, fought as a three-dimensional operation under the code name Just Cause, with no front-line negotiation and no exchange of prisoners. The authority to fire and the justification for it both sat in Washington: President George H. W. Bush approved the plan on 16 December and signed the order on the 17th, the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Colin Powell pushed the operational concept, General George B. Crist ran the theatre as commander in chief of Southern Command, and Lieutenant General James H. Collins of XVIII Airborne Corps commanded the ground forces committed. The main body of the ground effort was the 82nd Airborne Division, responsible for Panama City and the Canal Zone; the 7th Infantry Division (Light) handled the northern province of Colon and the Coco Solo line; the 1st Battalion, 61st Infantry and the 4th Battalion, 6th Infantry of the 5th Infantry Division (Light) and the 75th Ranger Regiment went to outlying objectives such as Rio Hato; the Joint Special Operations Task Force included Navy SEALs, the MH-6 light helicopters of the 160th Special Operations Aviation Group and night vision equipment, and large numbers of military police units entered the city to take over key installations. On the Panamanian side the Defence Force was held directly by Manuel Noriega, with a total strength of about sixteen thousand men, the great majority of them in Panama City and the Canal Zone and the rest dispersed across Colon, David and San Miguel. The air force had a handful of ageing A-37 attack aircraft and T-39 piston transports, the navy only patrol boats and river craft, no surface vessel capable of standing against the American fleets, and no formed main battle tank force at all. The real gap between the two sides lay not in numbers of men but in air superiority, night vision equipment, tactical aviation and airlift capacity.
people: 留下姓名的關鍵人物橫跨政界與軍界。美國一方，總統布希既是決策者也是對外發言人，12月20日上午他在開火之後向全國說出四項理由：保護在巴拿馬的三萬五千名美國公民、維護巴拿馬的民主與人權、打擊毒品資金與販運、維護《巴拿馬運河條約》的執行；參謀長聯席會議主席鮑威爾堅持把行動改稱「正義事業」，理由是再嚴厲的批評者在譴責時也不得不說出「正義事業」四字；南部司令部司令克里斯特中將負責戰區，第十八空降軍司令科林斯中將與第82空降師師長理查德·特納中將指揮市區作戰。巴拿馬方面，實際統治者曼努埃爾·諾列加自1967年起就是中央情報局在巴拿馬的線人，1988年2月因毒品指控被聯邦大陪審團起訴，同年11月在聯合國投票支持桑地諾陣線，與美方公開破裂；反對派領袖吉列爾莫·恩達拉在1989年5月的計票中以近三比一領先，選舉被宣布無效後於9月1日在美國使館宣誓組成流亡政府，12月20日開火數小時後在克萊頓堡宣誓就任總統，副手法比安·阿里斯蒂德斯隨後接任副總統。1989年10月失敗的政變由國防軍少校莫伊塞斯·希羅爾迪等人策劃，事後主謀被處決。戰場上的個人事蹟同樣密集：12月15日夜四名美軍軍人在喬里略區路障前被攔下，國防軍軍人開火，海軍陸戰隊中尉羅伯特·帕茲背部中彈，兩天後因傷重死亡，同行的海豹突擊隊中尉亞當·柯蒂斯與其妻邦妮被扣押毆打；喬治亞州本寧堡第988憲兵連上尉琳達·L·布雷率部與國防軍交火三小時，被媒體稱為第一位在戰場上帶領美軍部隊的女性。
peopleEn: The key figures whose names survive stretch across politics and the armed services. On the American side President Bush was both the decision maker and the spokesman to the country: in the morning of 20 December, after the firing had begun, he gave the nation four reasons, the protection of the thirty-five thousand American citizens in Panama, the defence of Panamanian democracy and human rights, the fight against drug money and drug trafficking, and the enforcement of the Panama Canal Treaty. The Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Colin Powell insisted on the name Just Cause on the ground that even the harshest critics, when condemning the American action, would have to utter the words Just Cause. General George B. Crist ran the theatre as commander in chief of Southern Command, while Lieutenant General James H. Collins of XVIII Airborne Corps and Lieutenant General Richard Turner of the 82nd Airborne Division directed the fighting in the city. On the Panamanian side Manuel Noriega, the real ruler, had been a CIA asset in Panama from 1967; he was indicted by a federal grand jury on drug charges in February 1988 and, after voting with the Sandinistas at the United Nations that same November, the break with Washington became public. The leader of the opposition Guillermo Endara led by nearly three to one in the May 1989 count; when the election was annulled he took the oath to form a government in exile at the American embassy on 1 September 1989, and a few hours after the fighting began on 20 December he was sworn in as president at Fort Clayton, with Fabian Aristides as vice president. The failed coup of October 1989 was plotted by men such as Major Moises Giroldi of the Defence Force, the principals being executed afterwards. The personal episodes of the fighting are equally dense: on the night of 15 December four American servicemen were stopped at a roadblock in the El Chorrillo district, the Defence Force opened fire, Marine Lieutenant Robert Paz was struck in the back and died of his wounds two days later, and Navy SEAL Lieutenant Adam Curtis and his wife Bonnie were detained and beaten. On the other side Captain Linda L. Bray of the 988th Military Police Company at Fort Benning, Georgia, fought the Defence Force for three hours and was described by the media as the first woman to lead American troops in battle.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是1985年列裝的M1A1艾布拉姆斯主戰坦克：120毫米滑膛炮、900匹馬力燃氣輪機、戰鬥全重約六十五噸，乘員四人，車尾彈藥架攜四十四至四十五發穿甲彈，另有12.7毫米並列機槍、7.62毫米同軸機槍與可發射拖佛的發射架，並配備車載資訊處理系統與熱成像瞄準具；它是美國陸軍裝甲師的制式主戰坦克，與M2布萊德利步兵戰車協同執行突破、防禦與要點占領。但這件兵器本身並未出現在巴拿馬。公開的戰鬥序列記錄顯示，投入巴拿馬的美國裝甲力量是輕裝的M551雪里登輕型坦克：第82空降師第3營第73裝甲營C連的裝甲排擔任拉科馬丹西亞總司令部的火力支援，四輛在1989年11月由C-5銀河秘密運抵霍華德空軍基地，另有十輛在開戰後數小時由C-141星式空投到托庫門國際機場，這是該型坦克唯一一次作戰空投；北部方向的第7步兵師（輕裝）同樣以輕型裝甲與M2布萊德利為主，第2輕裝甲偵察營的M113在縱深搜剿中擔任尖兵，巴拿馬國防軍則沒有成建制的主戰坦克。艾布拉姆斯之所以不適合這片戰場，理由是物理的：一輛滿載後近六十噸，再加上二十餘噸的燃油與彈藥補給，在巴拿馬城喬里略的狹窄街巷、斷牆與路障之間幾乎無法展開，機車道與水泥電線杆同樣限制它的轉向半徑，而C-141的空投上限也承載不了這種重量；十六噸的雪里登既能空投、能在運河區的狹窄堤道上行進，也能靠AH-1護航在市區提供直射火力。M1A1所代表的則是同一支軍隊在別處的戰爭方式：1989年美軍裝甲師正處於M1與M1A1的換裝期，第3步兵師與第24步兵師是M1A1的接收單位，兩年後第24步兵師即以二百四十一輛M1A1與二百二十一輛M2布萊德利投入海灣戰爭，那是艾布拉姆斯的第一場實戰。其餘裝備同樣值得記錄：AH-64A阿帕奇、AH-1W超級眼鏡蛇與UH-60黑鷹首次成建制投入城市戰，EF-111A渡鴉式對巴拿馬雷達網實施干擾，AC-130砲艇與F-117A隱形攻擊機打擊指揮部與機場，C-130大力神（部分加裝惡劣天氣空投系統）、C-141與C-5構成空運主力，悍馬高機動車首次大量使用，12月27日一架F-117A被擊中墜毀，飛行員彈射生還。巴拿馬國防軍的裝備是老式蘇系與中系混裝：AK-47與AKM步槍、RPG-7火箭筒、通用機槍與小口徑高射炮，另有1980年代美方供應的M16步槍與M2機槍；空軍的A-37與T-39在開戰首日被美軍戰機擊落，海軍的巡邏艇與內河汽艇則被海豹突擊隊在第一夜摧毀。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the M1A1 Abrams main battle tank, fielded in 1985: a 120mm smoothbore gun, a 900 horsepower gas turbine, a combat weight of some sixty-five tonnes, a crew of four, a bustle rack carrying forty-four to forty-five rounds of armour piercing ammunition, a 12.7mm machine gun, a 7.62mm coaxial machine gun and TOW missile launchers, plus a command and control vehicle and thermal imaging sights. It was the standard main battle tank of the US Army's armoured divisions, working with the M2 Bradley infantry fighting vehicle on breakthrough, defence and the seizure of key points. That tank itself did not appear in Panama. The public order of battle shows that the American armour committed there was the light M551 Sheridan light tank: a platoon from Company C, 3rd Battalion, 73rd Armor of the 82nd Airborne Division provided fire support for the assault on La Comandancia, with four vehicles secretly brought to Howard Air Force Base by C-5 Galaxy in November 1989 and ten more parachuted onto Tocumen International Airport by C-141 Starlifter within hours of the opening of the fighting, the only combat airdrop ever made with that type. In the northern sector the 7th Infantry Division (Light) was likewise built around light armour and the M2 Bradley, while the M113s of the 2nd Light Armored Reconnaissance Battalion served as scouts in the pursuit, and the Panamanian Defence Force had no formed main battle tank force at all. The reason an Abrams was unsuited to this battlefield is physical: a vehicle weighing close to sixty tonnes fully loaded, with twenty-odd tonnes of fuel and ammunition behind it, could hardly manoeuvre between the narrow streets, broken walls and barricades of El Chorrillo, and the machine-gun emplacements and concrete power poles constrained its turning radius just as badly, while the lift ceiling of the C-141 could not take that weight. The sixteen-tonne Sheridan could be dropped by parachute, could run along the narrow causeways of the Canal Zone, and could deliver direct fire in the city under AH-1 escort. What the M1A1 stands for is the way the same army fought elsewhere: in 1989 the US armoured divisions were in the middle of the changeover from the M1 to the M1A1, with the 3rd and 24th Infantry Divisions receiving the new model, and two years later the 24th Infantry Division went into the Gulf War with two hundred and forty-one M1A1s and two hundred and twenty-one M2 Bradleys, the first combat the Abrams ever saw. The rest of the equipment is equally worth recording: the AH-64A Apache, the AH-1W Super Cobra and the UH-60 Black Hawk went into urban combat in formed units for the first time; EF-111A Ravens jammed the Panamanian radar network; AC-130 gunships and F-117A stealth attack aircraft struck command posts and airfields; C-130 Herculans, some fitted with the adverse weather aerial delivery system, together with C-141s and C-5s formed the airlift; Humvees were used in bulk for the first time; and on 27 December an F-117A was hit and destroyed, the pilot ejecting safely. The Panamanian Defence Force carried an old mix of Soviet and Chinese patterns: AK-47 and AKM rifles, RPG-7 launchers, general purpose machine guns and light anti-aircraft guns, plus American supplied M16 rifles and M2 machine guns of the 1980s; the A-37s and T-39s of the air force were shot down by American fighters on the first day, and the patrol boats and river craft of the navy were destroyed by the SEALs on the first night.
tactics: 美軍的整套打法可以分成五段。第一段是外交與法律鋪墊：12月15日巴拿馬國民大會通過決議宣布與美國處於戰爭狀態，12月16日路障事件造成美軍軍人死亡，12月17日布希簽署命令，參謀長聯席會議把D日與H時定在12月20日凌晨一時；計畫本身一路改名，從保衛運河的演練計畫演到整合後的藍勺行動，最後改稱「正義事業」以維持正當性，美方還讓媒體以假想入侵的口徑報導計畫，1989年8月已有電視台播出把入侵寫成劇本的專題，配合軍事欺敵。第二段是制空與電子戰：EF-111A干擾巴拿馬的雷達網，AC-130砲艇與F-117A在夜間打擊國防軍指揮部與機場，F-117A、AH-64阿帕奇與悍馬車都在這場戰爭中第一次實戰。第三段是首夜的縱深奇襲：12月20日凌晨零時四十六分前後，第508空降步兵團第1營C連與第59工兵連的坑道工兵夜襲阿馬多爾堡，控制這個護衛運河太平洋入口、美洲大橋與大片油庫的要塞；海豹突擊隊在運河區攻擊國防軍第三旅指揮部與各處兵營，代號「利落包裹」的行動摧毀諾列加的私人專機並擊沉一艘巡邏艇，付出四名突擊隊員陣亡、九人受傷的代價；空降兵在市郊多點傘降，切斷泛美公路與運河區的連接。第四段是城市戰：第508團第1營逐屋爭奪國防軍總司令部拉科馬丹西亞，AH-64與AH-1W在低空用機炮掃射街壘，掩護步兵推進，M551雪里登在狹窄街道上提供直射火力，北部方向由第7步兵師推進並控制科倫與科科索羅，主要軍事行動到12月24日告一段落。第五段是佔領與秩序恢復：軍事警察進城逐屋搜索並收繳武器，「促進自由行動」接手解散國防軍與重建機構，1990年2月10日國防軍在法律上廢除，改組為公共部隊。整個過程有一點值得留意：美軍並未投入裝甲師的正面攻勢，而是以空運與傘降建立時間差，這既受巴拿馬城狹窄街道的物理條件所限，也回應了美方在政治上最為敏感的附帶損害顧慮。
tacticsEn: The American method falls into five stages. The first is diplomatic and legal preparation: on 15 December the Panamanian general assembly passed a resolution declaring a state of war with the United States, the roadblock incident of 16 December produced an American military death, Bush signed the order on the 17th, and the Joint Chiefs of Staff fixed D day and H hour as 0100 on 20 December. The plan itself changed names repeatedly, from the exercise plans written to defend the canal through the consolidated Blue Spoon plan and finally to Just Cause, so as to keep up its legitimacy, and the Americans fed the media a fictitious version of the plan to work with military deception: by August 1989 television had already carried a feature in which the invasion was written as a drama. The second stage is air superiority and electronic warfare: EF-111As jammed the Panamanian radar network, AC-130 gunships and F-117As struck command posts and airfields by night, and the F-117A, the AH-64 Apache and the Humvee all saw combat for the first time in this war. The third stage is the assault of the opening night: at about 0046 hours on 20 December, Company C of the 1st Battalion, 508th Parachute Infantry, together with the tunnel engineers of the 59th Engineer Company, assaulted Fort Amador by night and seized the fortress that guards the Pacific entrance of the canal, the Americas Bridge and the great oil storage area; SEALs struck the third brigade headquarters and the barracks in the Canal Zone, and the operation coded Nifty Package destroyed Noriega's private aircraft and sank a patrol boat at a cost of four assault men killed and nine wounded; paratroopers dropped in strength on several axes on the outskirts of the city, cutting the Pan-American Highway and the links into the zone. The fourth stage is the urban fight: the 1st Battalion of the 508th fought house by house for the Defence Force headquarters at La Comandancia, the AH-64 and the AH-1W fired their rotary cannon along the streets to cover the infantry, the M551 Sheridans gave direct fire in the narrow roads, and in the north the 7th Infantry Division advanced to take Colon and Coco Solo, the main military operations winding down by 24 December. The fifth stage is occupation and the restoration of order: military police searched house to house and collected weapons, Promote Freedom took over the task of breaking up the Defence Force and rebuilding institutions, and on 10 February 1990 the Defence Force was abolished in law and reorganised as the Public Force. One point of the whole operation is worth noting: the Americans did not commit an armoured division to a frontal assault, but built the time differential out of airlift and parachute landings, a choice dictated as much by the physical narrowness of Panama City's streets as by the political sensitivity of collateral damage.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾處。兵力方面，美軍史料記錄本次行動投入人員兩萬七千六百八十四人、軍機三百餘架，南方司令部估計巴拿馬國防軍約一萬六千人，而這是全境各營分散之後的總數。時間線清晰：12月15日巴拿馬宣布交戰，12月16日路障事件，12月17日下令，12月20日凌晨零時四十六分開火，主要軍事行動持續到12月24日，1990年1月3日諾列加正式投降，1990年1月31日「正義事業」結束，同年開始的「促進自由行動」一直運作到1994年9月。損失方面，美軍官方記錄為二十三人陣亡、三百二十五人受傷，其中二名陣亡者與十九名受傷者經認定為友軍誤傷；南方司令部統計巴拿馬國防軍陣亡約三百一十四人；戰區內其他損失的數字各方統計相差極大且互相矛盾，本檔案不採用任何單一數字。裝備與地理的數字也有據可查：M551雪里登有四輛在1989年11月先行運抵霍華德空軍基地，十輛在開戰後數小時空投托庫門；F-117A損失一架；抓獲諾列加的懸賞為一百萬美元；在巴拿馬的美國公民約三萬五千人；巴拿馬運河全長約八十公里；科倫是大西洋端的樞紐，托庫門國際機場是巴拿馬城的主要空港；投入作戰的美軍中女性約六百人，主要擔任軍事警察、運輸與直升機飛行任務。卡面那輛M1A1的諸項指標同樣可以核對：120毫米滑膛炮、四十四至四十五發車尾穿甲彈、約六十五噸戰鬥全重、乘員四人；而它在1991年海灣戰爭中的部隊規模是第24步兵師二萬五千餘人、三十四個營編制之內的二百四十一輛M1A1與二百二十一輛M2布萊德利，另有九十四架直升機。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are concentrated in a few places. On strength, the American records give twenty-seven thousand six hundred and eighty-four personnel and more than three hundred aircraft committed to the operation, while Southern Command estimated the Panamanian Defence Force at about sixteen thousand men, a total counted after the battalions had been dispersed across the country. The timeline is clear: Panama declares war on 15 December, the roadblock incident on 16 December, the order on 17 December, the opening of fire at 0046 hours on 20 December, the main military operations continuing to 24 December, Noriega's surrender on 3 January 1990, the end of Just Cause on 31 January 1990, and Promote Freedom, which began in the same year, running on until September 1994. On losses, the American official record gives twenty-three killed and three hundred and twenty-five wounded, of whom two dead and nineteen wounded were ruled to have been killed or hurt by friendly fire; Southern Command counted about three hundred and fourteen Panamanian military dead; the figures for other losses in the theatre differ enormously from source to source and contradict one another, and no single figure is adopted here. On equipment and geography: four of the M551 Sheridans were moved to Howard Air Force Base in November 1989 and ten more were dropped at Tocumen within hours of the opening of the fighting; one F-117A was lost; the reward for the capture of Noriega was one million dollars; there were about thirty-five thousand American citizens in Panama; the Panama Canal is about eighty kilometres long; Colon is the hub at the Atlantic end, and Tocumen International Airport is the main airport of Panama City; and of the troops committed about six hundred were women, serving chiefly as military police, drivers and helicopter pilots. The figures for the tank on the card can be checked as well: a 120mm smoothbore gun, forty-four to forty-five rounds of armour piercing ammunition in the bustle rack, a combat weight of about sixty-five tonnes and a crew of four; and in the Gulf War of 1991 its unit strength was the two hundred and forty-one M1A1s and two hundred and twenty-one M2 Bradleys of the 24th Infantry Division, within a division of more than twenty-five thousand men in thirty-four battalions and ninety-four helicopters.
cause: 打起來有四層原因，層層相扣。第一層是《巴拿馬運河條約》的倒數：1977年9月7日卡特與奧馬爾·托里霍斯簽署條約，運河區立即廢除，運河控制權最遲在1999年12月31日移交，條約同時要求運河繼續向美國船隻開放，而美方堅持巴拿馬必須由國民大會批准並切實執行協議，諾列加則以拖延回應。第二層是從盟友變成對手：諾列加自1967年起充當中央情報局的線人，在對付尼加拉瓜桑地諾陣線的戰爭中與美方合作並按年領取情報報酬，1986年里根政府要求他下台，赫什在《紐約時報》揭露毒品資金往來，1988年2月他被聯邦大陪審團起訴、3月眾議院通過要求他下台的決議、11月參議院削減援助，同年11月他在聯合國投票支持桑地諾陣線，關係公開破裂，1989年4月美方提出不要毒品也不要民主的交換條件並撤走南方司令部。第三層是1989年5月的大選與接連的挫敗：反對派聯盟的計票顯示恩達拉以近三比一領先，諾列加隨即宣布選舉無效，10月由國防軍少校希羅爾迪等人策劃的第二次政變被挫敗，12月15日國民大會宣布與美國交戰，12月16日路障事件造成美軍軍人死亡。第四層是雙方對時間的計算：諾列加認為美國在越南之後不會再打地面戰，反對派分裂、軍隊效忠自己，哥斯大黎加、委內瑞拉、哥倫比亞與西班牙的斡旋可以拖住美方；布希則認定諾列加已無法合法執政，而五角大樓內部如艾略特·艾布拉姆斯等幕僚自1988年起就主張武力解決，國內民意壓力又要求一次乾淨俐落的軍事結果。於是美方一面在邊界上以無視路障的挑釁性巡邏製造口實，一面把行動包裝成保衛民主與打擊毒品的正義之舉，最終在12月17日簽下命令。
causeEn: There are four layers of cause behind the fighting, each tied to the next. The first is the countdown under the Panama Canal Treaty: on 7 September 1977 Carter and Omar Torrijos signed the treaty, the Canal Zone was abolished at once, control of the canal was to pass to Panama no later than 31 December 1999, and the treaty required the canal to remain open to American shipping, while Washington insisted that Panama should first ratify and faithfully execute the agreements through its National Assembly, and Noriega answered with delay. The second layer is the process by which an ally became an enemy: Noriega had served as a CIA asset since 1967, had worked with Washington against the Sandinistas and drawn his retainer year by year; in 1986 the Reagan administration demanded his resignation, and Seymour Hersh exposed the drug money in the New York Times; in February 1988 he was indicted by a federal grand jury, in March the House of Representatives passed a resolution calling for his resignation, in November the Senate cut the aid, and in that same November he voted in the United Nations with the Sandinistas, the break became public, and in April 1989 Washington offered the terms of no drugs and no democracy and withdrew its Southern Command. The third layer is the election of May 1989 and the run of setbacks around it: the opposition alliance's count showed Endara leading Carlos Duque by nearly three to one, Noriega immediately declared the election void, the second coup of October, plotted by men such as Major Moises Giroldi, was defeated by the Defence Force, the National Assembly declared war on the United States on 15 December, and the roadblock incident of 16 December produced an American military death. The fourth layer is the arithmetic of time on both sides: Noriega reckoned that after Vietnam the United States would not fight a ground war on the ground, that the opposition was divided, that the army was loyal to him, and that mediation by Costa Rica, Venezuela, Colombia and Spain would hold the Americans off; Bush judged that Noriega could no longer rule legitimately, and in the Pentagon men such as Elliot Abrams had been pushing for a military answer since 1988, while domestic pressure demanded a clean and decisive military result. The Americans therefore produced incidents on the frontier with provocative patrols that ignored the roadblocks, and dressed the action up as the defence of democracy and the war on drugs, and on 17 December the order was signed.
impact: 巴拿馬的國家形態在這場戰爭之後被重塑。1990年2月10日恩達拉政府廢除國防軍，1990年4月運河區正式撤銷、美軍在巴拿馬的設施移交新政府，1990年12月31日《運河條約》經國民大會批准生效，1994年憲法修正案更永久廢除國家常備軍，只保留公共部隊與警衛隊。1999年12月31日運河主權按條約移交巴拿馬，成為該國財政與國家認同的核心；配合科隆自由貿易區、美元化與後來的運河擴建，巴拿馬逐步成為中美洲的物流與金融中心。國際層面同樣留下痕跡：12月22日美洲國家組織通過譴責決議並要求美軍撤軍，12月23日安理會要求撤軍的草案因美方否決而未獲通過，12月29日聯合國大會以七十五票贊成、二十票反對、四十票棄權通過譴責決議，歐洲議會與秘魯亦有譴責與召回大使之舉。學界主流看法是此舉違反《聯合國憲章》第二條與《美洲國家組織憲章》關於不干涉內政的條款；巴拿馬國民議會在2007年一致通過把12月20日定為國家哀悼日的決議，雖被當時的總統否決，巴拿馬政府仍在2019年12月19日宣布次日為全國哀悼日並降半旗。在美國方面，這場戰爭留下制度性的先例：法律顧問解釋，1878年的《地方保安隊法》只在美國境內有效，軍隊因此可以在海外執行聯邦逮捕令；五角大樓的作戰計畫模式、夜襲奪點的做法與有限目標的框定，兩年後被海灣戰爭直接沿用，成為冷戰後單邊干預的早期形態。諾列加本人於1990年被押往美國受審，1992年以販毒、詐騙與洗錢等八項罪名被判四十年監獄，後減為三十年，並被引渡回巴拿馬羈押，2017年5月29日在巴拿馬城病逝。1990年7月19日，六十家在巴拿馬經營的企業在紐約南區聯邦法院起訴美國政府，指控入侵行動執行草率，美國政府其後以每戶一筆重建補助的方式與其中部分原告了結。
impactEn: The shape of the Panamanian state was remade after this war. On 10 February 1990 the Endara government abolished the Defence Force; in April 1990 the Canal Zone was formally dissolved and the American installations in Panama were handed to the new government; on 31 December 1990 the Canal Treaty was approved by the National Assembly and took effect; and a 1994 amendment to the constitution abolished the national standing army for good, leaving only the Public Force and the National Guard. On 31 December 1999 sovereignty over the canal passed to Panama under the treaty, becoming the core of the country's finances and of its sense of itself; with the Colon free zone, dollarisation and the later expansion of the canal, Panama gradually became a logistics and financial centre of Central America. The international layer left its marks too. On 22 December the Organization of American States passed a resolution of condemnation and demanded the withdrawal of the American forces; on 23 December a Security Council draft calling for withdrawal was defeated by the American veto; on 29 December the General Assembly of the United Nations condemned the invasion by seventy-five votes to twenty with forty abstentions; the European Parliament and Peru likewise protested, Peru recalling its ambassador. The prevailing scholarly view is that the action violated Article 2 of the United Nations Charter and the provisions of the Charter of the Organization of American States on non-intervention; the Panamanian legislature voted unanimously in 2007 to designate 20 December a national day of mourning, which the president of the day vetoed, and the Panamanian government finally proclaimed the following 20 December a national day of mourning on 19 December 2019 and flew the flag at half mast. On the American side the war left an institutional precedent: legal advisers ruled that the Posse Comitatus Act of 1878 applies only within the United States, so that the military could act overseas to execute a federal arrest warrant; and the shape of the Pentagon's operational plan, the practice of seizing objectives by night assault and the framing of the campaign in terms of limited objectives were all taken over directly by the Gulf War two years later, forming an early shape of unilateral intervention after the Cold War. Noriega himself was taken to the United States for trial in 1990, convicted in 1992 on eight counts including drug trafficking, fraud and money laundering, sentenced to forty years and later reduced to thirty, and extradited back to Panama, where he died in Panama City on 29 May 2017. On 19 July 1990 sixty companies operating in Panama sued the United States government in the Southern District of New York, alleging that the invasion had been carried out in a negligent and reckless manner, and the American government afterwards settled with part of the plaintiffs by way of a rebuilding grant for each household.
result: 軍事結果非常明確：巴拿馬國防軍在首夜失去指揮系統，主要抵抗在12月24日結束，部隊被解散，軍人解甲，武器被收繳，1990年2月10日國防軍在法律上廢除，改組為巴拿馬公共部隊。諾列加的個人結局拖了兩週多：12月24日他躲入梵蒂岡駐巴拿馬城大使館求庇護，美軍在使館周邊晝夜播放音樂並進行全城搜捕，一百萬美元懸賞懸而未落，美方解釋播放音樂主要是防止竊聽談判內容而非心理戰；1990年1月3日諾列加正式向美軍投降，被送上MC-130E戰鬥爪運機送往美國，此後受審、判刑、引渡回國，2017年病逝於巴拿馬城。政治結果是恩達拉與阿里斯蒂德斯組成的政府上台，反對派聯盟在1990年5月的大選中獲勝，1994年又出現中美洲少數的和平政權輪替。戰術層面的教訓更值得記取：面對一個在首夜就被端掉指揮部、幾乎沒有制空權與海軍、幾乎沒有戰術航空兵與夜視器材的國家，抵抗只能退化成街壘中的殘餘抵抗；美軍取勝的關鍵不在某一種單兵，而在空運形成的時間差、縱深奇襲的節奏、近距火力密度，以及一整套從外交文件到資訊作戰的準備。裝備層面同樣留下一課：在運河區的狹窄街巷裡，能空投的輕型坦克比主戰坦克更合用，M1A1艾布拉姆斯要到1991年海灣戰爭那種大縱深正面攻勢中才第一次真正發揮火力。1999年12月31日，運河按條約交還巴拿馬，美軍在巴拿馬的駐軍隨之撤離，這場戰爭的軍事章節在那一刻才算真正收束。
resultEn: The military result was plain: the Panamanian Defence Force lost its command system on the first night, the main resistance ended on 24 December, the units were broken up, the men disarmed, the weapons collected, and on 10 February 1990 the Defence Force was abolished in law and reorganised as the Panamanian Public Force. The personal outcome of Noriega took more than two weeks longer: on 24 December he took refuge in the Vatican embassy in Panama City, the Americans played music day and night around the embassy and searched the whole city, and the one-million-dollar reward went unclaimed, the American side explaining that the music was played chiefly to prevent eavesdropping on the negotiations rather than as a psychological technique. On 3 January 1990 Noriega surrendered formally to the American forces and was carried off to the United States aboard an MC-130E Combat Talon, to be tried, sentenced, extradited back to his own country, and to die there in 2017. The political result was the coming to power of the government of Endara and Aristides, with the opposition alliance winning the election of May 1990 and a peaceful transfer of power following in 1994, one of the few in Central America. The lesson of the campaign at the tactical level is more worth keeping. Against a state whose command system was torn out on the first night, which had almost no air superiority and no navy, almost no tactical aviation and no night-vision equipment, resistance could degenerate into nothing more than a remnant resistance behind barricades. What decided the American success was not any single arm, but the time differential created by airlift, the tempo of the deep assaults, the density of close fire support, and an entire preparation running from diplomatic documents through the information war. The equipment lesson is equally plain: in the narrow streets of the Canal Zone, a tank that could be dropped by parachute was more useful than a main battle tank, and the M1A1 Abrams only put its main gun to work for the first time in the broad frontal offensives of the Gulf War in 1991. On 31 December 1999 the canal was handed back to Panama under the treaty and the American troops withdrew with it, and only at that moment was the military chapter of this war truly closed.
